{{Quote|Mandalorian named Kregg hunts the big game out in the jungles on the way to Kaas City, but he's gotten tired of sport-hunting.|[[Vort Norman]]|<ref name="TOR:PC" />}}
'''Deth Kregg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], he issued a challenge to anyone who dares defeat him and win both credits and glory. He was defeated by an Imperial spacer.<ref name="TOR:PC" />
